requirements.text: The application shall plot data points in a 3D environment based on provided tab-delimited text files.
The application shall label grid axes based on the column headers provided in the input data file.
The application shall color-code data points based on the cluster number attribute provided in the input data file.
The application shall support the visualization of up to 2000 data points.
The application shall display the name of a data point upon a single mouse click.
The application shall display all details of a data point upon a double-click.
The application shall allow the selection and display of names for multiple data points simultaneously.
The application shall provide user-controlled rotation, zoom, and movement of the 3D grid.
The application execution must be restricted to the server side.
The application shall start within 30 seconds, depending on the number of data points.
The interaction delay for selecting data points shall be no longer than 2 seconds.
The response time for grid orientation changes shall be fast enough to maintain user flow.
The application shall feature a professional look and feel suitable for research scientists.
The application shall use a color scheme that allows for clear printing on white backgrounds.
The application shall be intuitive and require no specialist training for operation.
The application must be compatible with both Windows and Linux operating systems.
The application shall run on a minimum of a mid-range personal computer.
The application shall support input via standard mouse and keyboard.
